comment: Fleet model policy — data, not code. Rules: 'best-overall' = highest-ranked model across all families for the agent's adapter; 'latest-family:<fam>' = newest version within one family; 'latest-same-tier' (default) = keep the agent's current family and tier (full/mini/nano), newest version. Effort: explicit value, or 'keep'. Rank order (claude): fable > opus > sonnet > haiku; (codex): larger version first, tier full > mini > nano.
